summary: This Form 6-K filed by Alpha Tau Medical Ltd., a foreign private issuer, reports clinical trial interim results for its Alpha DaRT therapy in recurrent glioblastoma. No special situation event is present; the filing simply discloses positive efficacy and safety data from three patients. There are no acquisitions, divestitures, activist campaigns, strategic reviews, tender offers, going-private transactions, capital returns, spin-offs, rights offerings, restructuring, liquidations, delistings, issuer tenders, deal terminations, SPACs, or management changes. The filing is a routine disclosure of business progress and does not constitute a special situation under the defined categories.
